Based on your profile (Year 2 IT student, CGPA 7.75), you are currently eligible to apply for two open grants. Please note that you may hold at most two research grants at the same time [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

### Open Grants
You may apply for the following grants, as your CGPA 7.75 meets the minimum requirements for both [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3]:

| Grant Code | Title | Amount | Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| GR-DS-05 | Data Science for Governance Fellowship | ₹50,000 | 31 Dec 2026 |
| GR-OS-11 | Open Source Contribution Grant | ₹25,000 | 31 Dec 2026 |

*   **GR-DS-05:** Requires a statement of purpose and your latest grade card [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **GR-OS-11:** Requires links to at least two merged pull requests and mentor contact details [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].

### Closed Grants
The following grant is currently closed and is no longer accepting applications:
*   **GR-HW-06 (Hardware Hackathon Seed Fund):** Status is closed [SQL].

**Note:** You are not eligible for **GR-SUS-08** (requires CGPA 8.0) or **GR-SP-14** (requires CGPA 9.0) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3]. Applications are only accepted while the status is open [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-OS-11', 'GR-DS-05', 'GR-HW-06']) ORDER BY application_deadline
